Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface UiScheduler

public interface UiScheduler
Schedules plugin work for runtime-controlled UI dispatch.

Callers must not assume a Swing, AWT, Cubism, or caller thread. The runtime admits and dispatches work according to its active UI host policy. Closing the returned registration cancels work that has not begun; it cannot undo work that has already started.

    • runOnUiThreadLater

      Registration runOnUiThreadLater(Runnable work, Duration delay)
      Schedules work for UI dispatch after a non-negative effective delay.

      Implementations may treat a negative duration as an immediate request. Closing the returned registration cancels the timer and prevents dispatch when possible.

      Parameters:
      work - non-null plugin work to dispatch
      delay - non-null requested delay
      Returns:
      a cancellation registration
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if work or delay is null
